title: Create a Content Repurposing Machine
description: Transform one pillar blog post into 10+ content pieces across platforms. You will write, extract, design, and organize — building a reusable workflow that saves hours of content creation time every week.
prerequisites: Completed Module 2 notes on content marketing and copywriting formulas
ChatGPT or Claude account for content generation assistance
Basic understanding of platform-specific content formats
Google Sheets or Notion for calendar organization
learning_outcomes: Write a pillar blog post following E-E-A-T guidelines
Extract platform-specific content from long-form content
Design social media carousels using Canva templates
Write short-form video scripts with hooks and CTAs
Build a content calendar spreadsheet for organized scheduling

steps.title: Write a Pillar Blog Post (1500 words)
steps.instructions:
1. Choose a topic in your niche that you can write about with genuine knowledge or experience. Examples:
   - 'How to Start a Small Business Instagram Page in India'
   - '7 Free AI Tools Every College Student Should Use'
   - 'A Complete Guide to Getting Your First Freelance Client'

2. Use ChatGPT/Claude to help you draft, but add your own examples and perspective. Prompt template:
   'Write a 1500-word blog post on [topic] targeting [audience] in India. Include 5 H2 sections, practical examples with Indian context (use ₹ for prices, Indian cities, Indian brands), and an FAQ with 4 questions. Follow E-E-A-T guidelines by including personal experience markers.'

3. Structure your post:
   - Title (include primary keyword, under 60 characters)
   - Introduction (hook + what reader will learn + why it matters — 100 words)
   - Section 1 with H2 heading (250 words)
   - Section 2 with H2 heading (250 words)
   - Section 3 with H2 heading (250 words)
   - Section 4 with H2 heading (250 words)
   - Section 5 with H2 heading (250 words)
   - FAQ Section (4 questions with 50-word answers each)
   - Conclusion with CTA (100 words)

4. Edit and improve:
   - Read it aloud — does it sound natural?
   - Check: Are there at least 3 Indian examples (brands, cities, prices in ₹)?
   - Check: Is each section actionable (can the reader DO something after reading)?
   - Check: Is it written in simple English (no jargon without explanation)?
   - Run it through Hemingway Editor (hemingwayapp.com) — aim for Grade 8 readability or below

5. Save the final blog post in a Google Doc or text file. This is your 'pillar content' — everything else will be extracted from this one piece.

Self-check: Your blog post should be between 1400-1600 words, have 5 clear sections, and at least 3 examples a student in Bhopal or Mughalsarai would relate to.

steps.title: Extract 10 Social Media Snippets
steps.instructions:
1. Read through your blog post and highlight these types of extractable content:
   - Statistics or numbers (turn into quote graphics)
   - Step-by-step instructions (turn into carousel slides)
   - Tips or advice (turn into individual social posts)
   - Questions readers might have (turn into polls or engagement posts)
   - Bold statements or opinions (turn into hooks)

2. Create these 10 snippets from your blog (copy into a new document):

   SNIPPET 1 — LinkedIn Text Post (200-250 words):
   - Take your strongest section and rewrite as a first-person LinkedIn post
   - Start with a hook line that stops the scroll
   - End with a question to invite comments
   - Add 3-5 relevant hashtags

   SNIPPET 2 — Twitter/X Thread (7 tweets):
   - Tweet 1: Bold hook statement from your blog intro
   - Tweets 2-6: One tip per tweet (extracted from your sections)
   - Tweet 7: Summary + CTA (follow for more)
   - Each tweet under 280 characters

   SNIPPET 3 — Instagram Caption (150 words):
   - Hook line (from your best section)
   - 3-4 bullet points of value
   - CTA: 'Save this for later'
   - 10 hashtags (mix of broad and niche)

   SNIPPET 4 — Email Newsletter Intro (100 words):
   - Subject line (from your blog title, reworded)
   - Opening hook (personal/relatable)
   - One key insight from the blog
   - CTA: 'Read the full post [link]'

   SNIPPET 5 — WhatsApp Status/Broadcast (50 words):
   - One-line hook from your blog
   - One tip (simplest, most actionable)
   - 'Reply YES for the full guide'

   SNIPPETS 6-8 — Three Quote Graphics (text only):
   - Extract 3 quotable lines from your blog
   - Each should be under 15 words
   - These will become Canva graphics later

   SNIPPET 9 — Poll Question (Instagram Stories/LinkedIn):
   - Turn one section into a question with 2-4 answer options
   - Example: 'What stops you from posting consistently?' → A) No time B) No ideas C) Fear of judgment D) Not sure what to post

   SNIPPET 10 — Infographic Outline:
   - Title (from blog title)
   - 5-7 bullet points (one from each section)
   - This will become a Pinterest/LinkedIn infographic

3. Save all 10 snippets in one document, clearly labeled.

Self-check: Each snippet should make complete sense on its own. Ask yourself — if someone saw ONLY this snippet (never the blog), would they get value from it?

steps.title: Design 3 Carousels in Canva
steps.instructions:
1. Open Canva and create 3 different carousels from your blog content:

   CAROUSEL 1 — Tips Carousel (Instagram, 1080x1350px):
   - Go to Canva > Create Design > Custom: 1080x1350
   - Slide 1: Hook title (biggest benefit from your blog) — use bold font, eye-catching color
   - Slides 2-6: One tip per slide (extracted from your 5 blog sections) — keep text large and minimal
   - Slide 7: Summary/recap of all tips in bullet points
   - Slide 8: CTA (Follow @yourhandle for more | Save this post)
   - Use consistent colors, fonts, and style across all slides
   - Rule: Maximum 30 words per slide

   CAROUSEL 2 — Myth-Buster Carousel (LinkedIn, 1080x1080px):
   - Take 3-4 common misconceptions related to your blog topic
   - Slide 1: 'Stop believing these myths about [topic]'
   - Slides 2-5: 'MYTH: [wrong belief]' → 'TRUTH: [correct information from your blog]'
   - Slide 6: 'Follow for more marketing truths'
   - Design tip: Use red/orange for myth, green for truth

   CAROUSEL 3 — Step-by-Step Carousel (Instagram, 1080x1080px):
   - Convert your most actionable blog section into a how-to
   - Slide 1: 'How to [achieve result] in [timeframe]'
   - Slides 2-6: Step 1 through Step 5 (one per slide)
   - Slide 7: 'Done! Now you know how to [result]'
   - Slide 8: CTA + your handle
   - Design tip: Number each step prominently

2. Design rules for all 3 carousels:
   - Use your brand colors (from Module 1 Brand Kit)
   - Same font family throughout (heading font + body font)
   - White space — do not overcrowd slides
   - Text size minimum 24pt (readable without zooming)
   - Add subtle design elements (shapes, icons) but keep focus on text

3. Export each carousel as PNG (individual slides) and also as a multi-page PDF.

4. Save Canva links so you can edit later (do not delete designs).

Self-check: Show your carousels to a classmate or friend. Ask them: 'Would you save this if you saw it in your feed?' If they say no, ask what would make them save it and redesign.

steps.title: Create 2 Short-Form Video Scripts
steps.instructions:
1. Write 2 video scripts (for Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts) extracted from your blog content:

   SCRIPT 1 — Educational Reel (45-60 seconds):
   Topic: Your strongest tip from the blog (the one that gives the most value in the shortest time)

   Format:
   [SECOND 0-3] HOOK
   Visual: [describe what viewer sees — e.g., you looking at camera, text on screen]
   Text on screen: [the hook text — bold, attention-grabbing]
   You say: '[Opening line — question or bold claim]'

   [SECOND 3-10] SETUP
   Visual: [transition or B-roll description]
   Text on screen: [context text]
   You say: '[Set up the problem or context in 2-3 sentences]'

   [SECOND 10-40] VALUE
   Visual: [main content delivery — talking head, screen recording, or B-roll]
   Text on screen: [key points as text overlays appearing one by one]
   You say: '[Deliver 3-4 actionable tips from your blog section]'

   [SECOND 40-50] KEY TAKEAWAY
   Visual: [emphasize main point]
   Text on screen: [one-line summary]
   You say: '[Summarize the most important thing to remember]'

   [SECOND 50-60] CTA
   Visual: [point to text on screen or gesture]
   Text on screen: 'Follow for more | Save this'
   You say: '[Tell them what to do next]'

   SCRIPT 2 — Relatable/Story Reel (30-45 seconds):
   Topic: A relatable pain point from your blog turned into a 'POV' or 'Things nobody tells you' format

   Format: Same structure as above but shorter and more emotional/relatable.
   Hook should be a relatable statement like: 'POV: You just realized [pain point from blog]'
   Body should be 2-3 quick tips that solve the pain point.
   End with: 'You are welcome. Follow for more.'

2. For each script, also specify:
   - Suggested background music style (e.g., 'upbeat lo-fi', 'trending audio', 'motivational')
   - Thumbnail/cover image idea (first frame that appears in grid)
   - 3 hashtags for discoverability
   - Best time to post in IST

3. Record yourself performing at least one of these scripts (optional but recommended for camera confidence practice). Use your phone camera in a well-lit quiet space.

Self-check: Read your scripts aloud with a timer. Script 1 should be 45-60 seconds, Script 2 should be 30-45 seconds. If too long, cut ruthlessly — every word must earn its place.

steps.title: Build a Content Calendar Spreadsheet
steps.instructions:
1. Open Google Sheets and create a new spreadsheet called 'Content Repurposing Calendar — [Your Topic]'

2. Create these columns:
   | Date | Day | Platform | Content Type | Topic/Title | Source Section | Format | Status | Link |

3. Fill in 14 days of content using ONLY the pieces you created from your one blog post:

   Day 1: LinkedIn Text Post (Snippet 1)
   Day 2: Instagram Carousel 1 — Tips
   Day 3: Twitter Thread (Snippet 2)
   Day 4: Instagram Reel Script 1 (record and post)
   Day 5: Instagram Quote Graphic 1 (Snippet 6)
   Day 6: Rest day
   Day 7: LinkedIn Carousel 2 — Myth Buster
   Day 8: Instagram Caption Post (Snippet 3)
   Day 9: Email Newsletter (Snippet 4)
   Day 10: Instagram Stories Poll (Snippet 9)
   Day 11: Instagram Reel Script 2
   Day 12: Instagram Quote Graphic 2 (Snippet 7)
   Day 13: Instagram Carousel 3 — Step by Step
   Day 14: WhatsApp Broadcast (Snippet 10) + Pinterest Infographic

4. For each row, fill in:
   - The exact date you would post
   - Which platform
   - Content type (Carousel, Reel, Text, Image, etc.)
   - Topic/Title (from your snippets)
   - Source section (which part of the blog this came from)
   - Format details (size, length)
   - Status (Planned / Created / Scheduled / Posted)
   - Link (Canva link or Google Doc link to the actual content)

5. Add a SUMMARY tab with these calculations:
   - Total pieces created from 1 blog post: [count]
   - Platforms covered: [list]
   - Content types used: [list]
   - Estimated time saved vs creating each from scratch: [your estimate]

6. Add a TEMPLATE tab with the repurposing workflow you just followed, so you can repeat this process every week with a new blog post.

7. Share the spreadsheet (set to 'Anyone with link can view') and save the link.

Self-check: Can you repeat this exact process next week with a new blog post? If yes, you have built a true content repurposing machine. If any step feels unclear, add more detail to your template tab.

Final deliverables for this lab:
- Original blog post (1500 words)
- 10 social media snippets document
- 3 Canva carousel links (exported as PNG/PDF too)
- 2 video scripts (with all production notes)
- Content calendar spreadsheet (14 days planned)
- Submit all links in one submission document.
